snippet.title: Skelemental: Monk's Fury - Gameplay Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Skelemental is a third-person Souls-like Action RPG where you play as the Skeleton Monk, a powerful Elemental Manipulator and adept martial artist. Reborn after a deadly betrayal, you scour a ravaged and corrupted land inspired by Japanese mythology to find your captured lover and exact revenge on the one who killed you.

Wishlist on Steam 👇
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2890660/Skelemental_Monks_Fury/
